description.zh: 指定要操作的API编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
description.en: The IDs of the APIs. Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered.

description.zh: 应用编号，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: 授权有效时间的截止时间，请设置格林尼治标准时间(GMT), 如果为空，即为授权永久有效。
description.en: The time (UTC) when the authorization expires. If this parameter is empty, the authorization does not expire.

description.zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**

- **TEST**

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者和API使用者
- API提供者可以授权自己的API给任意应用（app）调用
- API使用者可以将已购买的API授权给自己的应用（app）
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers and callers.

- API providers can authorize all applications to call their APIs.

- API callers can authorize their own applications to call the APIs that they have purchased.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-apis-authorities --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --app-id 2386789 --stage-name TEST --api-ids baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38,jkscc489e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f92d78 --description Query_weather_by_region_name --auth-valid-time Fri,05Oct201816:00:00GMT --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
